resources.name: IoTInspector
quotes: To this end, we utilize a crowdsourced dataset of IoT TLS traffic collected by IoT Inspector [23]
IoT Inspector is an open-source tool that crowdsourced the network traffic from 54,094 devices across 5,404 users worldwide [23].
references: Huang, D.Y., Apthorpe, N., Li, F., Acar, G., and Feamster, N. 2020. Iot inspector: Crowdsourcing labeled network traffic from smart home devices at scale. Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies (2020).
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The paper utilizes a crowdsourced dataset collected by IoT Inspector and describes it as an open-source tool used for the study.
